== Archived championship announcement ==

Added the announced Saturday 29 July championship, Friday 28 July side events, Twin City Comics venue and prize structure from the 18 June 2006 capture of Nick Kolnik’s forum announcement. The adjacent-topic URL (`view=next`) displays the Minnesota weekend title; the displayed topic was checked rather than guessed from the URL. <ref name="mn2006-announcement">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&amp;view=next 2006 Minnesota SWCCG State Championship Weekend], [[Nick Kolnik]], Players Committee Forums. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20060618095554/http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?t=9699&amp;view=next Internet Archive] (18 June 2006).</ref>

This pre-event announcement calls Brian Herold the defending champion; the separate DeckTech post explicitly says he won Minnesota States 2006 and was submitted on 31 July 2006, so the existing result is retained. The announcement’s outdated Worlds location is omitted. Personal contact details and preregistration details are omitted. The listed date remains marked scheduled because this source predates play.
